name: skip_the_second_copy
why: The benchmark of «suppress_instance»: a row of four holes that all fit, and one is removed. The volume must GO UP by exactly one hole, and the faces of the pattern go down by one.
_why_the_seed_is_at_the_center: The row starts from x=0 and goes 25 by 25: 0, 25, 50, 75 -- or 0, -25, -50, -75, depending on the direction of the edge, which SOLIDWORKS chooses and the case does not decide. On either side all four fit on a plate of +-100. It is something to be guaranteed, not hoped for: on a row that sticks out of the part SOLIDWORKS builds what it can and answers succeeded. This case learned it first-hand -- the first draft started from -60 with pitch 40 and `linear_pattern` refused, having counted one copy out of three.
_why_the_centers_have_a_minus_sign: On this plate the chosen edge runs towards -X, and the centres come out at -75, -50, -25, 0. The SIGN depends on the direction of the edge; what depends on nothing is that the holes are four, equidistant, and that after removing the second copy three remain with the gap in the middle. If one day the direction changed, this case would go red -- and that is right: it means something has changed and must be looked at.
_why_copies_are_counted_from_one: The original is not a copy. In `SkippedItemArray` index 2 is the SECOND copy after the original -- measured on 16/9/2026 on a row of four, looking at which hole disappeared. It is also the way whoever asks would count, so the number is passed as it is.

expect.tolerance_why: the centre is read from CylinderParams

expect.why: THREE COPIES, not four: the original is not a copy. It is the count that this case and the number of copies to remove must share, otherwise one of the two is counting something else.

expect.tolerance_why: 480000 minus four times pi*4.5^2*20: the calculation has pi inside

expect.why: the pattern owns one face per copy: three copies, three cylindrical faces

ENTRY Z-C21.2, finding L6-5 (review): the faces of the seed read from PatternFeatureArray, one cylindrical face per hole. If the reading failed the field would be null and the check «loss = faces per copy x copies removed» would not be done without anything saying so: this line is the way to see it

expect.tolerance_why: pi*4.5^2*20 = 1272.35: the calculation has pi inside
the remaining centres, read from CylinderParams
expect.why: THE LINE THAT SAYS WHICH. The volume would only say that a hole has disappeared, and it would be the same number for all three: only the centres say that the one at -50 has disappeared, that is the SECOND copy, and not another. The gap stays in the middle of the row, and it is the signature of this operation.

expect.tolerance_why: three holes instead of four, same calculation with pi inside

expect.why: AND WE GO BACK. An operation that only removed would leave the part in a state that can be left only by deleting the pattern. THIS STEP COST A RED, and it is the most instructive of the case: to empty the list you write «{0}», NOT an empty array. With the empty array `ModifyDefinition` answers true and changes nothing; with null the write raises RPC_E_SERVERFAULT and then answers true just the same. Two affirmative answers out of three ways that do not work: that is why the criterion here is the count of the faces and not the return value.

expect.tolerance_why: the same volume as before the removal
